name: Ariva: delivery from Azure DevOps
description: The move of Ariva's delivery to Azure DevOps and Dalil's Azure (owner request 2026-10-20; the plan is docs/plan/azure-devops-move.md). Today GitHub Actions is the gate and the dev release, and the Azure DevOps pipelines in Platform/Cloud/Ariva.Cicd/AzureDevOps exist but have never run: the pull request pipeline would fail as written, the image builds are unscanned and unsigned, and the release deploys a mutable tag without approval or signature checks. These stories bring the Azure pipelines to the GitHub ones' level, then cut over. Option A (GitHub stays the code's home, Azure Pipelines delivers) or Option B (Azure Repos becomes the home) is the owner's first decision; the stories say where they differ. Agents never run releases or change clusters; the steps in Azure DevOps and Azure are the owner's.

userStories.title: [E0] GitHub's files archived in github_archived/ (owner decision 2026-11-06)
userStories.description: The owner moved the repository to Azure Repos (organisation dalil, project Ariva; decision 1, Option B) and asked for everything GitHub runs to leave the project's working folders, to be deleted later. .github/ (the workflows, Dependabot, CODEOWNERS, the issue and pull request templates) moves whole to github_archived/, so GitHub Actions runs nothing and Dependabot's version updates stop (its alerts and security updates, secret scanning and push protection are repository settings and keep running on pushes to GitHub); the owner accepts no hosted CI until ARV-217 brings the Azure pull request gate to the GitHub gate's level. The checks that read the workflows keep reading them in the archive, the reference the Azure stories port from, until each moves to its Azure pipeline.
acceptanceCriteria: github_archived/ holds every file .github/ held, moved with git mv (history kept); .github/ no longer exists, and scripts/base-images.mjs --check refuses a .github file, folder or link (self-tested)

scripts/base-images.mjs (the Ryuk runners, the outside pins and their copies, the SDK, Helm, cosign and ZAP checks, the signing jobs, the third-party watch), Platform/Testing/Ariva.E2E/scripts/artifact-secrets.mjs (the backend log and mutation workflow wiring, the comment and pinned job checks) and NbjSiteScopeTests read github_archived/workflows; the archived third-party-images.yml paths filters name github_archived/workflows/**
scripts/security/scan.mjs's full scan oracle (MUST_LIST) names a file with no extension and a file in a dot folder in place of .github/CODEOWNERS, and its self-test passes

What only CI made fail fails in the local gates: scripts/verify.mjs sets ARIVA_GATE, under which chart-security.mjs fails without Helm or Helmfile, bundle.mjs's self-test without Helm, and Playwright without its database, Kafka and clamd or on a stray test.only (as under CI, GITHUB_ACTIONS or TF_BUILD); the build restores in locked mode first on Linux x64; node scripts/verify.mjs release builds in Release and runs NbjSiteScopeTests there, and checkpoint runs it

The docs name what runs nowhere until its Azure port (wiki 16 section 9: Trivy, the SBOM, cosign signing and verification, CodeQL, Semgrep CE, the AsyncAPI validation, the weekly ZAP baseline, the Release E2E run, Claude's review), ASVS V15.1.2 goes to Partly with the summary counts, and docs/product/decisions.md records the owner's decision and the residuals for the owner to confirm

The docs and wiki pages that name .github files name github_archived/ and say that GitHub runs nothing since 2026-11-06 (wiki 04, 13 and 16, overview.md, the security inventories and asvs-l2.md, the move plan); backlog/progress.md's history is left as written

node scripts/verify.mjs backend and docs pass; node scripts/base-images.mjs --check, artifact-secrets.mjs --self-test and scan.mjs --self-test pass; node scripts/security/scan.mjs passes with 0 errors
security-reviewer verdict PASS recorded in backlog/progress.md
userStories.notes: Size S. The CLAUDE.md files mention .github (the repository map, Platform/Cloud's pipelines line); agents do not edit them, so the wording is proposed to the owner. GitHub keeps its settings: a ruleset or branch protection on main that requires a GitHub check would refuse the owner's fast-forward, since no check runs any more. The dev container has Helm but not Helmfile, so its gates fail on the Helmfile environments until ARV-296.

acceptanceCriteria: The owner records decision 1 of docs/plan/azure-devops-move.md (Option A or B) in docs/product/decisions.md and an ADR-0016 amendment (Proposed until accepted)

docs/harness/azure-devops.md lists every setting the owner makes, step by step: the project, the code connection, and for Option B the import, the default branch, the build validation policy (Analyze-solution), reviewers, path-based required reviewers mirroring github_archived/CODEOWNERS (.github/CODEOWNERS until ARV-295), the merge type limited to rebase and fast-forward, force push and delete denied on main and v* tags

On GitHub, since ARV-295 archived the workflows: Actions disabled for the repository (or every workflow disabled), the repository secrets (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN) and the k8s-dev environment with its secrets deleted, and the tokens behind them revoked (the kubeconfig's service account token, the GHCR pull token, the Claude OAuth token, the Anthropic key); a ruleset restricts creating v* tags, since a tag pushed at a commit from before the archive would run its images.yml and sign as the identity scripts/offline/verify.mjs and the admission policy (wiki 04 section 6.5) trust

userStories.title: [E17] Azure pull request gate at the GitHub gate's level
userStories.description: Common/Analyze-solution.yaml would fail as written: it starts only PostgreSQL while the E2E configuration needs Kafka and Redis in CI, and it lacks the docs rules, the base image check, chart security with Helm and Helmfile, the offline bundle self-tests and dry run, the TLS check self-test, the vulnerable package list, the AsyncAPI validation and the test-count check that ci.yml runs. Its header still says trunk.
acceptanceCriteria: Analyze-solution.yaml runs every check ci.yml runs (or names each one it leaves out and why), with Kafka and Redis beside PostgreSQL pinned by the same digests, the same artifact secret check before anything is published, and main instead of trunk
A check (in scripts/base-images.mjs or its own script, self-tested) compares the two gates' step lists and fails when ci.yml gains a check the Azure gate lacks
A run on Azure DevOps passes on the branch (run by the owner; its result recorded in backlog/progress.md)
node scripts/verify.mjs quick passes, and node scripts/security/scan.mjs passes with 0 errors
security-reviewer verdict PASS recorded in backlog/progress.md
docs and wiki pages affected by the change are updated (node scripts/verify.mjs docs passes)
userStories.notes: Size M. 2026-10-25 (ARV-164a, ARV-164b): ci.yml runs both test suites as their executables (Microsoft Testing Platform) and then scripts/test-count-guard.mjs on each TRX; Analyze-solution's DotNetCoreCLI test task still runs them through dotnet test (VSTest), whose adapter can drop a case, a failing one included, without failing the run. Run the executables and the guard as ci.yml does. 2026-10-28 (ARV-252): ci.yml writes both suites' output to unit.log and integration.log, checks them and the TRX files with artifact-secrets.mjs before printing, quoting or uploading any of it (backendLogWiring holds the wiring); the Azure gate's logs are the project's own, not public, but its published test results are artifacts: check them the same way before they are published. 2026-11-06 (ARV-295): ci.yml, mutation.yml and security-scan.yml are archived in github_archived/; port from there, and move the checks that read them (scripts/base-images.mjs, artifact-secrets.mjs, NbjSiteScopeTests) to the Azure pipeline. ARV-295: chart-security.mjs and bundle.mjs fail closed under TF_BUILD (as under CI and the local gates' ARIVA_GATE), so the Azure gate needs Helm 3.19.0 and Helmfile 1.1.7; the Release proof and the E2E run against Release hosts (ARIVA_E2E_CONFIGURATION=Release) belong in it too.
